name: Demonstration academic rules
standing_rules: Evaluated after each term with final grades, using cumulative GPA (CGPA) vs the level minimum: GOOD/none -> WARNING if CGPA below min; WARNING -> PROBATION if CGPA still below; PROBATION -> DISMISSED if CGPA and term GPA both below, stays PROBATION if only CGPA below; any -> GOOD when CGPA at or above min.
withdrawal_rule: Synthetic business rule: more than 3 consecutive missed regular terms records an UNOFFICIAL withdrawal at the next missed term's census; admission history is never modified
poor_performance_rule: Term GPA below level good-standing minimum OR passed share of graded credits below 0.5
gpa_rule: Credit-weighted mean of grade points of all graded attempts (W and IP excluded), per student programme
